idea-plugin.name: GoToInOppositeGroup
idea-plugin.description:
Provides two actions that open the implementation of the symbol under the caret directly in another editor split/group: Goto Implementation in Opposite Group puts it in the opposite group, while Goto Implementation in Right Split always puts it in a group to the right.

When working with two vertical editor splits (a common setup on wide monitors), checking the implementation of a method or class normally requires two separate steps: first "Goto Implementation" to resolve the symbol, then "Open File in Opposite Group" to move it to the other split. This plugin combines both steps into a single action.

Features:

  • Navigate to a symbol's implementation directly in the opposite editor split
  • Or always navigate into a split to the right, whichever group you start from
  • Automatically creates a split if one does not exist
  • Keeps your current editor position intact
  • Available from the Navigate menu, editor context menu, and Search Everywhere

Especially useful for C++ developers and anyone who frequently investigates implementations while keeping their current context intact.

action.description: Navigate to the implementation of the symbol under the caret in the opposite editor split
Navigate to the implementation of the symbol under the caret in a split to the right
